A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. About Anthropic, PBC (Coinbase Tokenized Stock) (ANTc)

Anthropic, PBC (Coinbase Tokenized Stock) is an onchain certificate that provides economic exposure to shares of Anthropic, PBC through a tokenized security issued by Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM).

Each token initially represents a 1:1 beneficial interest in shares held in a segregated custody account with a regulated broker-dealer and custodian. The applicable share-to-token ratio may change over time to reflect reinvested distributions, fees, taxes, corporate actions, and other adjustments.

The token can be held and transferred through supported blockchain networks and used in decentralized finance markets. Dividends and other distributions received on the underlying shares are generally reinvested, after applicable taxes, fees, and expenses, with the resulting economic benefit reflected through an adjustment to the share-to-token ratio.

What Is Anthropic, PBC (Coinbase Tokenized Stock)?

Anthropic, PBC (Coinbase Tokenized Stock) is part of Coinbase's onchain capital-markets infrastructure, designed to represent traditional financial instruments as regulated digital securities.

The token is a certificate over shares rather than a direct investment in Anthropic, PBC. Each token represents a proportional beneficial interest in the pool of underlying shares and related property held on trust by Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd. The underlying shares are held in segregated custody, while Onchain Marketplace Ltd operates the tokenization infrastructure and maintains the definitive legal ownership register in its capacity as a Central Securities Depositary.

Authorized Participants create tokens by delivering the corresponding underlying shares or subscription value. Eligible holders who satisfy applicable vesting, identity-verification, sanctions, and compliance requirements may redeem tokens for the underlying shares or through another supported settlement method.

Zypher Network is a decentralized protocol building the trust infrastructure for the AI agent economy. As AI agents increasingly manage financial flows, compliance processes, customer support, and automated operations, Zypher tackles the core challenge: agent execution today is opaque, unverifiable, and vulnerable to manipulation. By applying advanced cryptographic schemes and a modular blockchain stack, Zypher enables transparent, tamper-resistant verification for autonomous agentic systems—much like SSL transformed the web into a secure environment.
At its core, Zypher introduces Proof of Prompt (PoP), a cryptographic protocol that links an input prompt to its resulting output in a verifiable way. Through proxy signing, encryption, and distributed validation, PoP ensures that agent instructions and responses remain intact, traceable, and auditable without revealing sensitive data. Zypher extends this foundation into a full product suite, including the AI Security Browser, which gives users real-time trust ratings for AI agents, and a RESTful API & SDK that allow developers to embed integrity verification and performance scoring directly into their applications.
The network is powered by Zytron, an AI-optimized execution layer built on BNB Chain. Zytron supports high-throughput agent workloads with heterogeneous compute resources and leverages a Proof of Verifiable Work mechanism to coordinate validation tasks across a decentralized prover community. This design enables scalable, low-latency proof generation suitable for millions of daily verifications.
For end users, Zypher makes AI safety participatory. Its Proof Mining system allows the community to validate agent outputs, detect anomalies, and contribute ratings across twelve safety and usability dimensions. Participants earn tokens and NFTs for their contributions, creating an incentive layer similar to a decentralized “TrustPilot for AI Agents.” By combining enterprise-grade auditing with community feedback, Zypher offers both developers and consumers a transparent way to evaluate and trust AI services.
